entries.text: I am tired from the events this week . I am also a little anxious about upcoming events .   This time of year is hard . I am looking forward to summer , but there’s a lot to do before then . I also get anxious when I have a lot of free time . I feel like I have to fill the time .

I am feeling okay . I am nervous about this weekend and how I will make everyone feel special . I have a lot to do . 200 words is a lot of words .   I hope my weekend goes well . Right now my dogs are barking and that is adding to my stress .

I am feeling pretty good . It’s the end of the school year . I am floundering a little bit , because there’s a lot of work to do and I am not sure where to start . I’ll feel better when I get to work tomorrow .
